h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Aligarh

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Aligarh

items.pText: Aligarh is famous for its locks and hardware, so many buyers here know metalwork well and ask sharp questions about it. FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment for Aligarh's schools, colleges, housing colonies and parks. We fabricate, roto-mould and inspect everything in-house at our factory in Vasai, about 1,080 km away. It then goes by road and is installed by our own team or a dealer.

The most common question we hear from Aligarh is how our steel is protected. The posts and frames are galvanised pipe, which means the steel carries a zinc coating that protects it against rust. That is different from painted mild steel, which looks the same on day one but starts to rust where the paint chips. Our slides, panels and seats are roto-moulded plastic, which cannot rust at all. The warranty reflects this, with 3 years on galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts.

richText.heading: What to check in a playground quote

c: When you compare quotes for an Aligarh school or society, ask each supplier the same questions:

items: Are the pipes galvanised or only painted?
Are slides and panels roto-moulded, and in how many colours?
What does the warranty cover, and for how long on springs and bearings?
Will they send a layout drawing showing the safe play area?

items.q: What is the difference between galvanised and painted steel?
items.a: Galvanised steel has a zinc coating that protects it from rust even if the surface is scratched. Painted mild steel rusts wherever the paint chips. Our posts and frames are galvanised pipe.

items.q: Do you make the equipment yourselves?
items.a: Yes. Design, fabrication and roto-moulding are done in-house at our 45,000 sq ft factory in Vasai, and every piece goes through our own quality inspection before dispatch.

items.q: Can a college campus in Aligarh order both play and gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. Many campuses want a play area for staff families and an outdoor gym for students. We can plan both on one layout drawing and send them in the same dispatch.
